title: A shared normalized tensor comparison preserves the two local projection mates
statement: Fix a finite-field datum D, coefficient datum C and finite extension E of Q_l. Let H be SixFunctorHigherOperations D C E [def-sf-operation-stages]. The functor on integral pairs given by the integral tensor followed by raw rationalization equals the pair of rationalizations followed by the prescribed rational tensor. Construct its tensor comparison from this proved equality. With this one tensor comparison, and with the operation comparisons H.rationalization, localization carries each specified compact-support projection component to the rational component through the source and target endpoint isomorphisms. It also carries the proper counit projection mate to its rational counterpart through the direct-image source and target endpoints [def-sf-constructible-projection-mates]. These are local two-input squares, with no coherence assumption, no assertion of any comparison equation, and no separatedness assumption on structure morphisms.

source.place: Compatibility: operation comparisons respect units, counits and tensor; the proper/open construction in prop-sf-pf-coherence.proof.md

proof.text: Use the shared canonical tensor comparison and its functor equality from the tensor-model normalization module. They are the same equality and eqToIso construction as before the extraction.
The compact-support local mate square is the named compact-support component statement, obtained by expanding the open and proper mates and pasting their normalized endpoint comparisons.
The proper counit local mate square is the named proper component statement, obtained by transposing under the direct-image adjunction and using the normalized tensor-pullback comparison.

lean.statement:
theorem rationalProjectionTensorCompatibility
    {D : FiniteFieldDatum.{u}} {C : D.CoefficientDatum}
    {E : Type u} [Field E] [Algebra (Padic C.l) E]
    [FiniteDimensional (Padic C.l) E] (H : SixFunctorHigherOperations D C E) :
      (∀ {X Y : SixFunctorSpace D} (f : X ⟶ Y)
        (c : Compactification f.hom.left)
        (K : sfIntegralConstructibleCategory C.l E X.obj.left)
        (L : sfIntegralConstructibleCategory C.l E Y.obj.left),
        (sfRationalConstructibleLocalization C.l E Y.obj.left).map
            (compactSupportProjectionComponent H.integralExchange f c K L) ≫
          (target H.rationalization
            (rationalProjectionTensorComparison H) f c K L).hom =
        (source H.rationalization
          (rationalProjectionTensorComparison H) f c K L).hom ≫
          compactSupportProjectionComponent H.rationalExchange f c
            ((sfRationalConstructibleLocalization C.l E X.obj.left).obj K)
            ((sfRationalConstructibleLocalization C.l E Y.obj.left).obj L)) ∧
      (∀ {X Y : SixFunctorSpace D} (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsProper f.hom.left]
        (K : sfIntegralConstructibleCategory C.l E X.obj.left)
        (L : sfIntegralConstructibleCategory C.l E Y.obj.left),
        (sfRationalConstructibleLocalization C.l E Y.obj.left).map
            (compactSupportProperProjection H.integralExchange f K L) ≫
          (properTarget H.rationalization
            (rationalProjectionTensorComparison H) f K L).hom =
        (properSource H.rationalization
          (rationalProjectionTensorComparison H) f K L).hom ≫
          compactSupportProperProjection H.rationalExchange f
            ((sfRationalConstructibleLocalization C.l E X.obj.left).obj K)
            ((sfRationalConstructibleLocalization C.l E Y.obj.left).obj L))
